summary: The exact fixture authorization and immutable regression inputs preserve the intended boundary, but the tested-to-reviewed suffix rewrites existing evidence and fails the merge gate.

findings.title: Append the selected check registry without rewriting existing evidence
findings.description: The governance record binds tested_commit bb2cf012895e16b07e247f3497183c4b8eb847ee. Commit 2f2c02816e9c15e9b558aaa09c56433b2e4faade changes checks.json, which already existed at that tested revision. governance_suffix_errors rejects any post-test modification of existing evidence, even when the new registry references successful logs. Consequently the required governance merge gate fails with governance-tested-evidence-not-addition:docs/exec-plans/evidence/HG-032/checks.json.
findings.reproduction: Import tools/harness/validate_harness.py and evaluate governance_suffix_errors(root, bb2cf012895e16b07e247f3497183c4b8eb847ee, 2f2c02816e9c15e9b558aaa09c56433b2e4faade, HG-032, tested). It returns the existing-evidence modification error.
findings.requested_change: Preserve checks.json bytes from tested_commit and append the verified check registry under a new revision-specific evidence path. Refresh the governance exact file declaration and obtain fresh independent review of the resulting bookkeeping revision.

verification: Independently read AGENTS, current authority index, pr-merge-reviewer skill, governance/review/merge contracts and schemas, HG-032 record, KL-024 packet, protected-base diff and committed evidence.

Verified HG-032 schema conformance and exact 44-file protected-base-to-reviewed declaration. The protected base has no KL-024 result and HG-032 is unused there. Only KL-024 task metadata changes, by adding the exact transaction fixture write path; all checks, statuses and other task definitions remain unchanged.
Verified every index checksum and manifest checksum/byte count. The unchanged base/head specialist review union is GENERAL, PROTOCOL and DB_CONCURRENCY.

Reran the committed read-only audit at reviewed HEAD: Frozen, product, migration, database-test, completed, requirement, integration and milestone paths remain unchanged; source evidence copies match their exact source SHA; the BLOCKED KL-024 record and one-failed-57-passed uniqueness collision are preserved.

Inspected the source fixture and additive migration evidence. Moving INTENT to 2026-09-27 collides with active INTENT_2; the proposed 2026-09-28 date retains the head-day mismatch against 2026-09-26, the GuardRequired assertion, restoration and successful atomic completion.

Inspected the byte-exact guard and negative tests: committed base/head bytes must match the sole permitted literal substitution, and wrong dates, altered assertions, skips, restoration edits and unrelated bytes are rejected. The regression inputs now read immutable protected-base Git bytes.

Reran future_fixture.py at reviewed HEAD. Its disposable clone applies only the proposed fixture change, passes all 49 scope regressions and removes the clone; the governance fixture remains byte-identical.

Audited selected -verified.log checks: all commands, tested_commit bb2cf01 and exit_code 0 match the record. Committed evidence reports 228 harness and 202 unit cases passing, plus validation, lint and typecheck. Historical failures are retained and are not selected as PASS evidence.

Verified the tested-to-reviewed suffix contains only governance/evidence bookkeeping, then reproduced its single existing-evidence modification failure for checks.json. No expensive full suite or database suite was rerun.
limitations: KL-024 remains historical BLOCKED source evidence; governance neither implements the fixture repair nor establishes task, product, release or merge PASS.
This CHANGES_REQUIRED record binds the reviewed SHA above. Corrected bookkeeping requires a new independent SHA-bound review.
